name: neurawork-cc-harness
description: NeuraWork Claude Code harness: repo-local, self-maintaining project knowledge. Bundles three independently installable skills — knowledge-compiler (distils session logs into a per-repo knowledge base), claudemd-lerner (keeps the CLAUDE.md hierarchy + docs/ current), and compliance-compiler (parallel agents distil GDPR/SOC2/ISO27001 into a tracked constraint catalog, derive the capabilities and stack components those constraints require, and a PostToolUse hook validates PRP plans against both). Knowledge, docs, and the catalog always live inside the repo, never in .claude/. Recon + brownfield seed/extract on install so existing repos can be upgraded.
